Risk Statement: File may be sent to an unapproved recipient or destination because the production allowlist is not confirmed
Mitigation: Approve exact recipients and destination before production
Required Evidence: Approved recipient list and allowlist screenshot

Risk Statement: API authentication and authorization pattern is not selected
Mitigation: Select approved pattern and complete security review
Assign rollback owner and rehearse recovery

Risk Statement: Dashboard and file totals may diverge due to rounding or model-version differences
Mitigation: Define reconciliation tolerance and compare transformation versions

Risk Statement: Data-retention period and privacy disposition are not documented
Mitigation: Complete privacy review and retention decision

Risk Statement: Failed transfer may not create a timely incident or customer notification
Mitigation: Define receipt SLA and incident thresholds

Risk Statement: Customer approval delay could compress final UAT and launch review
Mitigation: Set approval due dates and escalation cadence

Risk Statement: Service-account ownership may be unclear after launch
Mitigation: Assign owner and quarterly access review
Required Evidence: Approved access record and review schedule
